nodes.name: Pick today's post
nodes.notes: Reads the calendar and series files (incl. Monday Reels) and queued trend posts. Posts after POST_TIME on calendar days; does nothing on rest days.

nodes.name: Publish to Instagram
nodes.notes: DRY_RUN=true in .env: only makes the images. Refreshes the Instagram token weekly.

nodes.name: Publish story
nodes.notes: Never fails the run: a Story problem only logs and alerts.

nodes.name: Find trend, write post
nodes.notes: TRENDS=true in .env switches this on. Queues at most TREND_MAX_PER_WEEK posts; each waits TREND_DELAY_MINUTES for a Stop tap.
